title: File:From One Crew to Another- Artemis II Astronauts Meet NASA Barge Crew (from-one-crew-to-another-artemis-ii-astronauts-meet-nasa-barge-crew - maf-071424-victor-glover-visits-pegasus-bh-5).jpg
desc: Members of the Artemis II crew met with the crew of NASA’s Pegasus barge prior to their departure to deliver the core stage of NASA’s SLS (Space Launch System) rocket to the Space Coast. NASA astronaut and pilot of the Artemis II mission Victor Glover met the crew July 15. From left to right: Ashley
